process.title: How we [work]
process.intro: A clear process from the first message to the final files. Every step below is written into the quotation before work begins.

steps.title: Brief
steps.text: Send a request with a short brief. We discuss your goals, timing and the details of the project.

steps.title: Quotation
steps.text: You receive a written quotation covering scope, deliverables, timeline, price and payment terms.

steps.title: Deposit
steps.text: Work begins once the quotation is approved and a 50% deposit is paid.

steps.title: First draft
steps.text: I present the first results for your feedback and approval.

steps.title: Revisions
steps.text: Three rounds of revisions are included. Additional rounds are charged at the rate stated in the quotation.

steps.title: Delivery
steps.text: After final approval and the remaining 50% payment, the final files are delivered in full.

items.q: How much does a project cost?
items.a: Every project is different, so pricing follows a short conversation about your needs. Send a request with your brief and you will receive a clear quotation with no hidden costs.

items.q: How long does a project take?
items.a: It depends on the scope. The quotation states the timeline, which starts once the deposit is paid and all the materials needed from you are received.
A round of changes to the approved direction. A new idea or a change of direction is treated as a new request.

items.q: Do you work with clients outside the UAE?
items.a: Yes. Design, 3D, drawing and editing are delivered fully online. Filming and photography are available in the UAE.
You receive full rights to use the final files once the last payment is made. I may show the work in my portfolio unless we agree otherwise.
Yes. Many projects combine design, 3D and video. Tell me what you need and I will put together one package.

cta: Tell me about your project and I will reply with next steps and a quotation.
